out_items.name: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated

violations.title: Package Integrity
violations.observation: The following food item(s) from damaged packaging were found offered for sale or service: OBSERVED ~12 CANS OF GROUND BEAN SAUCE TO BE RUSTED AROUND ALL EDGES IN DRY STORAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Food packages such as canned goods shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the food is not exposed to adulteration or potential contaminants. Return all dented and damaged canned goods to your food supplier for a credit. CDI: ALL RUSTED CANS DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION. Hot Deli @ 99 Ranch Market (Inspection Date: 05/19/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: OBSERVED RAW DUCK STORED OVER RAW CUTTLEFISH IN WALK-IN COOLER
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CDI: CUTTLEFISH MOVED TO DIFFERENT SHELF. PIC/MANAGER RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED IN (4): RAW FISH STORED ABOVE RICE NOODLES
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: COOLER REARRANGED/FISH PUT BENEATH RTE FOODS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED COOKED PORK DIMSUM ON COUNTER AT 119F (30MIN) OBSERVED SOYMILK AT 85F (1HR) IN A STEAM TABLE. STEAM TABLE WATER WAS AROUND 95F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: REHEATED TO 169F DURING INSPECTION. STEAM TABLE WATER REPLACED WITH HOT WATER, SET TO MAX, AND SOY MILK HEATED.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 door under counter cooler located across from the cookline ( cooler 4 in temperature report)
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PIC replaced thermometer

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The sink basin at the handwashing sink next to the three com. Apartment sink doesn’t drain.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC called plumber to repair handwashing sink.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Observed handwashing sink next to the three compartment sink in the rear kitchen area doesn’t not have hot water available during the time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC called facility maintenance to fix hot water issue.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: radish cakes (101F)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC had employee reheat radish cakes to 165F

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-First Aid Supplies Not Contained
violations.observation: First Aid Supplies are not being stored in a kit or container, observed first aid kit being stored over an active food prep surface
violations.corrective_action: Store all first aid supplies in a kit or container that is located to preclude the accidental contamination of food, food equipment, and other food contact surfaces. PIC moved first aid to a space where it could not t contaminate food or food prep surfaces.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: EHS observed pig ears thawing on the counter next to the wok line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS informed PCI that TCS foods need to be thawed under refrigeration or running water, PIC moved pork ears to the Walk in Cooler

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: pork was being thawed in the compartment prep sink under standing, non running water
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS informed PIC of issue with thawing TCS foods in standing water, PIC turned on water for thawing pork.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sugar spice, soy sauce, msg, teriyaki sauce in working containers on the wok line
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC agreed to make labels for working containers of food.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: door is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means to the back hallway of the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. PIC agreed to retrain staff to keep the rear door closed

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Design
violations.observation: Insect control device does not retain the insects within the device, observed a residential electrical handheld fly swatter being used in the kitchen that did not retain pests
violations.corrective_action: If insect control devices electrocute or stun insects, the device shall be designed to catch and hold the insects. EHS had PIC remove fly swatter from the kitchen area

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: rice scoops next to the rice cooker being stored in standing unheated water
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS had PIC remove scoops from water

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under 3 compartment sink sanitize basin are leaking and causing ponding on the floor of the Kitchen area
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC agreed to have 3 compartment sink repaired by next inspection

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed water ponding on the floor of the kitchen area near the 3 compartment sink and the wok line.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS informed PIC that facility needed to be cleaned and mopped on frequency that prevent ponding from occurring in the kitchen area.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO PAPER TOWELS AT HAND SINK IN MIDDLE OF SERVING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM PROVIDED PAPER TOWELS UPON REQUEST. CFM WILL RESTOCK PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: SESAME PANCAKE, VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS AT HOT BAR.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE MARK SESAME PANCAKE AND OTHER FOOD ITEMS AT HOT BAR WITH END POINT.

violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. - CFM TO HAVE EMPLOYEES COVER ALL FOODS IN STORAGE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. - OBSERVED CONTAINER OF BROCCOLI ON FLOOR UNDERNEATH COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. - CFM MOVED CONTAINER TO TOP OF PREP TABLE. Hot Deli @ 99 Ranch Market (Inspection Date: 10/31/2024) Page 2 of 3
